status: PASS universal square-root signed-turn bound for vertex-simple square-lattice paths
analytic: For n>=2, deleting half of each endpoint edge leaves length n-1 and every original internal turn. Quarter-circle smoothing inside disjoint radius<1/4 vertex neighborhoods preserves embeddedness, is regular C1, keeps the same signed tangent lift and shortens length. Unit square-lattice vertex simplicity excludes all nonincident edge intersections.

On the closed secant triangle s<=t, the normalized nonzero secant extends continuously to the tangent on the diagonal. Regular C1 gives continuity uniformly there. Contractibility supplies a single real lift, hence tangent increment is EXACTLY A-A_reverse, not merely modulo2pi.

An endpoint is an original edge midpoint. After lattice rotation its perpendicular ray has x=1/2 and misses all vertex rounding neighborhoods and all vertical edges. Its intersections with the smoothed arc remain distinct horizontal-edge midpoints at nonzero integer heights, including any terminal midpoint intersection.

For nonnegative endpoint increment A, first hits of pi/2+2pi*j have distinct positive heights h_i. Between successive first hits, continuity forces a downward-ray hit at an integer height<=-1. Therefore length>=2sum(h_i)-h_k+2(k-1)>=k^2+2(k-1). The unordered-height inequality uses coefficient2 on all but the possibly largest final height and is valid without monotonic radial ordering. Reflection handles negative A.

Thus |A|<2pi sqrt(length)+pi/2, and likewise at the reversed endpoint. Their exact difference yields |R-L|<8sqrt(n-1)+2. n0/1 have zero internal turn. Square spirals give matching Theta(sqrt(n)) order; constant8 is not optimality claim.

The optional edge-simple noncrossing-contact extension requires every interior degree-four visit to use disjoint adjacent-edge pairings. Local disjoint smoothing preserves the itinerary and all signed turns; endpoint truncation removes endpoint-only contacts. Transverse or repeated-edge walks are not included.
scope: Pure embedded square-lattice geometry, no ant capture or global recurrence application assumed. Fixed construction controls corroborate, not establish the universal proof.
